changes: Added a post-DONE packages/main build hook for runtime-affecting merges, extended it to done_recover, and covered package-local lockfile triggers plus recovery cleanup ordering.
usage: Continue using lattice story_advance DONE and done_recover normally; when packages/main runtime inputs changed, the CLI now refreshes packages/main/dist automatically after the local main merge.
expectedOutcome: After a runtime-affecting packages/main story reaches DONE or is recovered through done_recover, the global thin lattice CLI sees the refreshed dist without a manual npm build.
actualTranscript: Ran npm --prefix packages/main run build, npm --prefix packages/main run test:worktree-authority-smoke, npm --prefix packages/main run test:flow-stability-smoke, and KOALA_SESSION_ID=sess-350de45eaf0f0f51 lattice validate --story=B-c3b0 --json; all passed with 9/9 verification intent coverage.
outcomeDiff: Expected and actual match before DONE. The final live signal is expected during story_advance DONE, which should print the packages/main build refreshed line because this story changes packages/main/src.
limitations: Normal DONE runtime success/failure is covered through the shared helper and call-site review rather than a full real npm build inside every smoke fixture; this was accepted by coverage review to avoid slow/uncontrolled smoke behavior.
pitfalls: Keep the hook targeted to runtime inputs only; making it unconditional would waste time on docs-only stories, while moving done_recover build before cleanup can recreate partial-DONE residue on build failure.
